# Native interface input custody

Two actual native source cases fail against the published conversion contract:
concrete error boxing and a wider interface converted to error both return a
contract refusal instead of the exact source parameter. Extend the existing
ConversionOperand request with MakeInterface and ChangeInterface. Go owns type
conversion semantics; Primitive authenticates the selected instruction and its
direct input. No second operand catalog or compatibility contract is introduced.

For each form challenge intact, foreign, untaken, cloned, nil, typed-nil,
self-referential, foreign-owner, missing-view and cancellation boundaries.
The finite oracle covers four source representations, taken/untaken blocks
and an optional preceding call; its expectation is source parameter identity,
not a copied implementation algorithm. Fuzz this same oracle for three seconds.
Retain the failing baseline, exact failed-only rerun, selected scalar regression
proof, race and tool results. Deliberately dropping the input, instruction
membership, input custody or untaken refusal must fail an actual assertion.

Measure the query after compilation at native prefixes of32 and8193 calls;
benchmark for three seconds after test/tool proof, then fuzz separately. These
measurements exclude native whole-unit compilation and do not claim constant
execution time. Release allocation occurs only after proof and fresh upstream,
index, config and owned-source checks. Independent acceptance remains external.
